description:
Detects Access Token Manipulation: Impersonation (T1134.001)

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_mitre_attack_mitre_0611", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" IN ('CreateAuthToken', 'UpdateAuthToken', 'DeleteAuthToken', 'CreateCustomerSecretKey', 'DeleteCustomerSecretKey') AND "value" > 0
